messages.subject: Office costs — proposal to sublet half the floor
messages.body:
Liebe Alle,

Now that roughly 40% of the team works from home most days, the first floor is honestly half empty. I counted: on a typical Tuesday we use 12 of the 22 desks.

Proposal: sublet the first floor (about half our space) from June 1. Based on comparable listings on the same street, we could recover around €3,100/month, which covers the lease almost 50/50. The people next door already asked me last year whether we had space.

We'd need a partition wall and separate badge access, roughly €2,500 one-off, but the payback is under a month at that recovery rate.

Danke,
Lena

messages.subject: RE: Office costs — proposal to sublet half the floor
messages.body:
Dear Marta, dear Lena,

I have looked at the numbers and I can support the sublet concept. At approximately €3,100 per month recovered against our €6,200 lease, the annual saving is in the region of €37,200, which is material given the migration and pentest outlays this quarter. The one-off partition cost is manageable within my contingency line.

I would gently note two caveats: we should confirm that subletting is permitted under clause 8 of the lease, and we must retain sufficient space for the launch-week all-hands and customer visits. I trust Lena's desk-count, though I might suggest we measure occupancy over a full two weeks rather than a single Tuesday before committing to which half we sublet.

Kind regards,
Helen
Helen Oyelaran | Chief Financial Officer | Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Office costs — proposal to sublet half the floor
messages.body:
Hola equipo,

Pushback from me: we still do client demos in the office — Redline and Swiftbox both visited in March. If a subtenant is on the first floor I need the meeting rooms and demo setup to stay untouched, no exceptions. Also, where does everyone sit when the whole team is in for the launch all-hands? 🚀

Happy either way as long as the demo room and the good coffee machine stay ours.

Saludos,
Tomás

messages.subject: RE: Office costs — proposal to sublet half the floor
messages.body:
Tomás,

Fair points. Meeting rooms, demo setup and the coffee machine are all on the ground floor and would stay fully ours. The first floor is desks and storage only.

Also: I checked the lease, clause 8.2 allows subletting with written landlord consent, and Rob already said verbally he'd look at it favourably — he'd rather have a paying subtenant than renegotiate with us. And we kept the alternative in mind (breaking the lease outright), but the penalty plus fit-out of any new space would swallow the saving, so this is the cheaper route.

Danke,
Lena

messages.subject: RE: Office costs — proposal to sublet half the floor
messages.body:
ok, do the sublet from june 1. demo room stays ours. lena handles it.

M
Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: RE: Office costs — proposal to sublet half the floor
messages.body:
Noted — I'll get the landlord's written consent this week and put the first-floor listing out. Target start June 1, and Tomás, the demo room is safe. 💪

Danke,
Lena
